profile.headline: Creative Technologist & Full-Stack Developer · 30 years of making emerging technology tangible · GenAI · Unreal Engine · XR · Virtual Production · Interactive Design
profile.summary:
For 30 years I've been making emerging technology tangible, translating what's new and experimental into products, experiences and prototypes that actually ship.
I specialize in the intersection of creative and technical: Generative AI, XR, Virtual Production, and full-stack development. I'm as comfortable in Unreal Engine as I am in a Node.js codebase.
Two things I've built that I'm proud of: virtual production sets used across SAP's immersive studios in London, Amsterdam and Germany and Chirbit, an audio platform I founded and ran for 14 years that 150,000 registered users  genuinely used.
I'm always interested in connecting with people working at the edge of what's possible, whether that's a new enterprise experience, an AI-powered prototype, or an immersive environment.

positions.title: Creative Technologist - Full Stack Developer - Experience Lab & Co-Innovation Services
positions.description:
I build frontier technology prototypes and immersive experiences for SAP's global experience centers and enterprise clients. My work sits at the intersection of creative direction and full-stack engineering — from concept to deployed product.
Recent work includes developing AI Human installations for SAP's Experience Center in Palo Alto and a pop-up store on the SAP campus in Waldorf, Germany — both currently active. Built on Tavus for the digital human layer, with a custom backend giving the AI real-time tool access — including a web scraper and API I built to surface local sports schedules when the official source blocked iframe embedding. The result is a conversational AI installation that feels genuinely useful, not just impressive.

positions.title: Virtual Production Unreal Engine Artist Fellowship
positions.description: Selected from across SAP for a 6-month fellowship to build virtual production environments for SAP's immersive broadcast studios in London, Amsterdam, and Germany. Delivered 5 production-ready virtual sets in Unreal Engine — each used across multiple live internal and external events — modeling assets in Blender, authoring PBR textures in Substance Painter, and collaborating directly with the studio installation agency to meet broadcast-quality standards. Also mentored colleagues on Unreal Engine workflows, helping grow the team's internal virtual production capability.

positions.title: Founder/Programmer
positions.description: Founded and built Chirbit from the ground up — a web platform for recording, uploading and sharing audio. Ran it as a solo technical founder for 14 years, handling product, engineering, and design end to end. Grew the platform to 150,000 registered users. Shutting it down after 14 years was a deliberate decision — it was a long-running proof that I can conceive, build and sustain a product independently.
positions.insights: Skills: User Interface Design · User Experience · Interaction Design · Creative Direction

positions.title: Senior Mobile and Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Joined the Hybris team following a restructuring of SAP's mobile division. While mobile remained my focus, project demand in that space was limited within this team. I used the time productively — deepening my front-end skills across Vue.js, Angular, and the broader Hybris stack, and continuing to track and experiment with emerging technologies independently. Ultimately I sought out and moved into a role better aligned with my core focus: innovation, prototyping and emerging tech.
positions.insights: Skills: User Interface Design · HTML 5 · NodeJS

positions.title: Senior Mobile Developer - Mobility Innovation Center
positions.description: Built iOS and Android prototypes for SAP's sales teams to demonstrate enterprise mobility concepts to clients. Explored emerging platforms — beacons, IoT, wearables, voice interfaces, geolocation — and translated them into working demos ahead of market adoption. Developed RESTful APIs to connect prototypes to live SAP back-end data, and delivered across the full stack when needed. Won the SAP TechEd InnoJam 2013 as part of the team behind Crowdify.
positions.insights: Skills: Interaction Design · User Experience · NodeJS

positions.title: Owner, Digital Media Producer
positions.description: Ran an independent digital media studio for 16 years, producing motion graphics, HD video, rich media and high-end presentation work for clients. Built and sustained a creative business through multiple technology shifts — from early web to HD video to interactive media — which required staying ahead of the curve technically while delivering commercially.
positions.insights: Skills: Digital Media · Creative Technology · 3D · Motion Graphics · After Effects

positions.title: Motion Graphics Artist
positions.description: Early career role producing motion graphics for one of the world's most recognized brands, grounding my visual craft in a high-standards production environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Graphic Design · Data Visualization · Photoshop · After Effects · 3D

educations.schoolName: Savannah College of Art and Design
